#!/bin/bash
input=$(cat)
c=$(printf '%s' "$input" | node -e "const d=require('fs').readFileSync(0,'utf8');const j=JSON.parse(d);process.stdout.write(j.tool_input?.command||'')")
if ! echo "$c" | grep -qE '(npm run dev|pnpm( run)? dev|yarn dev|bun run dev)'; then :; exit 0; fi

# Check if tmux is available first
if ! command -v tmux >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  :
  exit 0
fi

cmd=$(printf '%s' "$input" | node -e "const d=require('fs').readFileSync(0,'utf8');const j=JSON.parse(d);process.stdout.write(j.tool_input?.command||'')")

# Block dev servers that aren't run in tmux
if [ -z "$TMUX" ]; then
  echo '[Hook] BLOCKED: Dev server must run in tmux for log access' >&2
  echo '[Hook] Use this command instead:' >&2
  echo "[Hook] tmux new-session -d -s dev 'npm run dev'" >&2
  echo '[Hook] Then: tmux attach -t dev' >&2
  exit 2
fi

:

PreToolUse.description: Block dev servers outside tmux - ensures you can access logs
Reminder to use tmux for long-running commands
Remind before git push to review intended changes (never blocks)
Block creation of random .md files - keeps docs consolidated
Warn when editing files that are already >500 lines - suggests splitting into smaller modules

hooks.command:
#!/bin/bash
# TDD Guard: 缺少对应测试文件时请求确认（permissionDecision=ask，非硬阻断）
# 设 AUTO_TDD_STRICT=true 可恢复 deny 硬阻断
input=$(cat)
fp=$(printf '%s' "$input" | node -e "const d=require('fs').readFileSync(0,'utf8');const j=JSON.parse(d);process.stdout.write(j.tool_input?.file_path||'')")
if ! echo "$fp" | grep -qE '\.(js|ts|jsx|tsx|java|py|go|rs)$'; then exit 0; fi

decision="ask"
[ "$AUTO_TDD_STRICT" = "true" ] && decision="deny"

emit() {
  node -e "const d=process.argv[1];process.stdout.write(JSON.stringify({hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:'PreToolUse',permissionDecision:process.argv[2],permissionDecisionReason:d}}))" "$1" "$decision"
  exit 0
}

CLAUDE_HOME="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-${CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR:-$HOME/.claude}/auto-cli}"
guard_script="${CLAUDE_HOME}/hooks/lib/tdd-guard-cli.js"
if [ -f "$guard_script" ]; then
  reason=$(node "$guard_script" "$fp" 2>&1)
  rc=$?
  if [ $rc -ne 0 ]; then
    paths=$(echo "$reason" | grep "Expected test paths" | sed "s/.*checked: //")
    emit "未找到 $fp 的对应测试文件（期望之一：${paths:-<none>}）。TDD 建议先写测试（RED）再实现（GREEN）。"
  fi
  exit 0
fi

# 回退：无 guard 脚本时做内联检查
dir=$(dirname "$fp"); base=$(basename "$fp"); noext="${base%.*}"
for ext in test.js spec.js test.ts spec.ts; do
  [ -f "$dir/${noext}.${ext}" ] && exit 0
  [ -f "$dir/__tests__/${noext}.${ext}" ] && exit 0
done
emit "TDD Guard: 未找到 $fp 的对应测试文件。建议先写测试（RED）再实现（GREEN）。"

PreToolUse.description: TDD Guard: 缺测试文件时以 permissionDecision=ask 请求确认（AUTO_TDD_STRICT=true 时改为 deny 硬阻断）

Auto-snapshot: non-destructive Git snapshot of HEAD, index and non-ignored working files before Write/Edit with 3+ dirty files; restore only into a new independent directory. Failure blocks the pending edit.

PostToolUse.description: Log PR URL and provide review command after PR creation
Read-only lint: local Prettier --check and ESLint checks; no formatting or auto-fix
TypeScript check with error count and actionable output
Warn about console.log statements after edits
Remind to commit when 5+ files have uncommitted changes - encourages frequent incremental commits
Skill health reminder: suggest skill-evaluator after editing skills/*.md or SKILL.md (warn never block)
Incremental review: accumulate dirty file list only for an explicitly bound run/actor/prompt; unknown identity is unattributed. See skills/incremental-review/SKILL.md

hooks.command:
#!/bin/bash
# List old run candidates; never move files from SessionStart
# Main workflow must review state, references and paths before archiving
CLAUDE_HOME="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-${CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR:-$HOME/.claude}/auto-cli}"
clean_script="${CLAUDE_HOME}/hooks/lib/auto-clean-runs.sh"
if [ -f "$clean_script" ]; then
  bash "$clean_script" 2>&1 || true
fi
exit 0

SessionStart.description: SessionStart: surface CLAUDE.md / .auto/constitution.md, native identity receipt and only bound session-continuity.md + list old run candidates without moving files (informational, never blocks)

SubagentStart.description: SubagentStart: expose native worker identity receipt; only an explicit preregistered delegation handshake binds a run

PostCompact.description: Persist a reminder only for a confirmed controller binding after compaction; ambiguous identity is unattributed (no immediate model injection)

PreCompact.description: Persist a reminder only for a confirmed controller binding; PreCompact cannot deliver non-blocking model context

UserPromptSubmit.description: Warn if user prompt contains potential secrets (API keys, tokens)

TeammateIdle.description: Remind team lead to check task list and assign work when teammate goes idle

TaskCompleted.description: Quality reminder - surface uncommitted changes when a task completes (warn only, never blocks)

Stop.description: Final audit for console.log in modified files before session ends
If the explicitly bound controller run lacks metrics.json, run scripts/generate-metrics.js; workers and unattributed events cannot summarize a run
